python3 << 'PY'
import re, pathlib
root = pathlib.Path('web')
# Extract title=, aria-label=, and visible text-ish strings from live files only
files = [root/'index.html', root/'viewer.js']
patterns = [
    r'title="([^"]+)"',
    r"title='([^']+)'",
    r'aria-label="([^"]+)"',
    r"aria-label='([^']+)'",
    r'textContent\s*=\s*[`\'"]([^`\'"]+)[`\'"]',
    r'innerHTML\s*=\s*[`\'"]([^`\'"]+)[`\'"]',
]
# jargon / lag candidates relative to established vocabulary
flags = re.compile(
    r'shorten|simplified path|simplif(?:y|ication)|algorithm|Fréchet|tolerance|thresh|'
    r'Douglas|looking for|Upper Match|Smaller keeps|Larger keeps|dropping points|'
    r'search spacing|the search|original path|path shortener|stream(?:ing)?|'
    r'classic |being processed|still being|ruled out|retain |Metric\b|'
    r'Candidate(?! markers)|Cand\b|Layers\b|Fit to data|Load Trace|'
    r'original\.txt|Baseline|Compression|cell size|file match|max error|'
    r'search radius|Current search|Allowed area|Still-allowed|Next landing|'
    r'Path so far|Full result|Original path|Anchor points|Dead candidates|'
    r'path step|alive|pts\b|Computing trace|Select trace',
    re.I
)
for f in files:
    text = f.read_text()
    print(f'=== {f} ===')
    seen=set()
    for pat in patterns:
        for m in re.finditer(pat, text):
            s = m.group(1)
            if flags.search(s) and s not in seen:
                # skip internal comments already handled; filter obvious false positives
                if 'Fréchet distance (technical)' in s: 
                    continue
                seen.add(s)
                print('-', s[:180])
    # also scan template literals that are multi-line status strings
    for m in re.finditer(r'`([^`]{8,220})`', text):
        s = m.group(1).replace('\n',' ')
        if flags.search(s) and s not in seen and '${' not in s[:3]:
            # skip code-heavy
            if any(x in s for x in ['function','const ','=>','document.','querySelector']):
                continue
            seen.add(s)
            print('~', s[:180])
print('done')
PY
